title: Corn Polenta with Roasted Mushrooms and Grana Padano
subtitle: creamy polenta topped with shaved cheese
description: Creamy polenta enriched with butter, cream and grana padano is topped with quickly seared mushrooms and shavings of cheese that melt on contact. Serve immediately.

steps.text: Melt the butter in a wide pot. Pour in the boiling stock (or water) and milk and bring back to the boil.

Pour in the polenta very slowly, stirring slowly and constantly until the liquid is absorbed, which can take a few minutes. Keep cooking over low heat, stirring, until the polenta thickens and you feel resistance when stirring.
Add the cream and salt and keep stirring until thick and smooth. Add 50 g of grated grana padano and stir gently until it is absorbed. Keep warm.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a pan, add the sliced mushrooms, season with salt and pepper and saute for 2 to 3 minutes until browned.
Divide the polenta between plates, top with a mound of mushrooms and the remaining grana padano shaved with a vegetable peeler, which melts slightly on the hot mushrooms. Serve immediately.
